note: Versions this kit was last reconciled against. Update only after a human read the upstream diff and confirmed the mechanism still holds. Each component declares how it is fetched - adding a component is a change here, not in code. An unknown 'kind' or a component that cannot be fetched makes the watcher exit 2 ('could not check'), never 'no drift'.
